FINANCE DEPARTMENT
NOTIFICATION
The 16th March 2015
No. 6335—FIN-SMS-SS-0070/2013-F.—In pursuance of provisions contained in paragraph 8
of Odisha Small Savings Incentive Scheme Rules, 2000 as amended from time to time, the list of
the prize winning coupon numbers of Small Savings Incentive Scheme of “AL” Series draw held on
the 1st March, 2015 at Jayadev Bhawan, Bhubaneswar is published below for general information
of public.
